gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with SIU LEK YUEN ROAD and running in a south-westerly direction for about 790 metres where it terminates at a turning circle as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/ST/R21A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由小瀝源路之會合處起，向西南伸展約七百九十米而終止於一迴旋處，在圖則第LD/ST/R21A號以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street extending as a continuation of NGAN SHING STREET (which was gazetted vide G.N. 3369/81) and running generally in a south south-westerly direction for about 200 metres and then turns to run south south-easterly for about 520 metres where it terminates at its junction with an unnamed road (indicated as Road P5 on Drawing No. LD/ST/R21A) as shown coloured pink and hatched black on the said Drawing.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街乃銀城街之延續（銀城街已在憲報公佈，見憲示一九八一年第三三六九號），向西南偏南伸展約二百米，再轉向東南偏南伸展約五百二十米至與一未名道路（圖則第LD/ST/R21A號內P5號道路）之會合處止，在該圖則中以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with an unnamed road and running in a north-westerly direction for about 8 metres and then bends to run north north-westerly for about 155 metres, then it turns to run generally northerly for about 40 metres to terminate at its closed end as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. LD/ST/R24A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與一未名道路之會合處起，向西北伸展約八米，轉向西北偏北伸展約一百五十五米，再大致轉向北伸展約四十米至盡頭處止，在圖則第LD/ST/R24A號以粉紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with a turning circle at the north-eastern corner of Fo Tan Cottage Area and running in an east north-easterly direction for about 55 metres and then curves to run north-easterly for about 50 metres and then turns to run north north-easterly for about 150 metres, it then bends to run north-westerly for about 26 metres to terminate at its closed end as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. LD/ST/R25.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與在火炭平房區東北角迴旋處之會合處起，向東北偏東伸展約五十五米，轉向東北伸展約五十米，又轉向東北偏北伸展約一百五十米，再轉向西北伸展約二十六米至盡頭處止，在圖則第LD/ST/R25號以粉紅色標明。
